name: ScreensDesign
summary: Library of 2,700+ iOS apps with onboarding, paywall and retention screens, flows and revenue estimates, plus an AI screen generator.
description: Mobile app design and UX research library for designers, founders and product teams: full session recordings, onboarding and permission flows, paywall and pricing screens, subscription cancellation and recovery, retention patterns and App Store screenshots from 2,783 top-chart iOS apps, with revenue and download estimates where available. Browse by screen type, recorded flow, UI element or app category; public articles and guides explain the patterns behind the screens. Premium library features, the AI screen generator and MCP access need an account and plan.
contains: 2,783 apps in the top charts with screens, flows, videos and store screens
revenue estimates shown per app (e.g. $45K–$250K per month)
browse by screen type, recorded flow, UI element, app category and collection
paywall and monetization research: trials, credits, gating, upgrades, cancellation
public guides and articles with evidence links; premium library and MCP for accounts
App Store screenshots, animation explorer and web onboardings sections
recorded flows show ordered steps within real app tasks
MCP integration connects AI clients to the library on premium plans
